stem: The mean mass of 9 packages waiting at a mail counter is 2.4 kilograms. Another package, with a mass of 1.4 kilograms, is added to the group. What is the mean mass, in kilograms, of the 10 packages?
solution: The total mass of the 9 packages is \(9 \cdot 2.4 = 21.6\) kilograms.
With the new package, the total is \(21.6 + 1.4 = 23\) kilograms for 10 packages.
verify:
m = (9 * Rational('2.4') + Rational('1.4')) / 10
assert m == Rational(23, 10)
assert all(Rational(s) == m for s in spr_answers)
